name: Resurrection
overview: Scripture reveals the resurrection as a profound hope grounded in the reality of Christ as the living Redeemer who will stand on the earth in the last days, affirming life beyond death. Job's reflections express a longing for a set time when the dead will awaken, emphasizing the certainty of life after death and the transformative change that awaits believers. The account of Abraham offering a ram in place of Isaac symbolizes God's provision and foreshadows the ultimate resurrection through Christ, who embodies the promise of new life.
